title: Search Linear with AI: find the issue you half remember
h1: find a linear issue from the words you remember
description: Find Linear issues by a phrase, title or issue reference with an AI bot. Include archived work when needed and see why team filters need another action.
answer: you can ask a bot to find the linear ticket about a problem without remembering its exact title. it searches issue titles, descriptions and issue references, then brings the matches to your chat. archived issues are left out unless you ask for them. this is a text search: asking for a team or assignee does not turn those words into filters.
og_line: the ticket behind a half-remembered phrase.
what:
give the bot the phrase you remember, such as a particular error message or a feature name. it can search active issues or include archived work, which helps when an old fix disappears from the usual views.

results arrive in groups of up to 50, with 25 returned by default. the bot can keep reading further groups. for a search confined to a team, it needs the separate list issues by team action; this search cannot filter by team, project, owner, state or label.
uses: find the ticket that mentioned a customer seeing a blank screen after signing in
look up an archived investigation before reopening the same technical question
collect issues mentioning an exact error phrase for a support call
recover a ticket when all you remember is a few words from its description

routine.message: every monday at 11, search linear for the phrase 'password reset' and include archived issues. read through the available matches and bring me the issue titles and references here, marking archived results separately. explain when a match is only a loose text match. never edit, reopen or create an issue.
routine.needs: linear connected, with read only access for this bot
routine.output:
password reset matches

web-84: reset link opens a blank page, active.
web-19: reset email delay reported by mira at vellumworks, archived.

these are text matches, not a team-filtered list.

steps: add linear under **Connected apps** and give the search bot **read only** access.
name a phrase you remember and say whether old, archived work belongs in the results.
try a search in chat and check the titles against what you meant; ask for the next group if the first is incomplete.
send the recurring search message when you have a topic worth checking regularly, then use **Pause** on its card if the topic stops being useful.
watch: a team name in the search text is just text. use list issues by team when the team boundary matters.
archived work stays hidden by default, so an empty search does not rule out an old issue.
a single response holds at most 50 issues. the bot should read further results before calling its list complete.

faq.q: can it search comments inside linear issues?
faq.a: this search covers the issue reference, title and description. it does not search the comment discussion; finding a ticket and reading its comments are separate jobs.

faq.q: how do i find a ticket without its number?
faq.a: describe the problem or quote part of the title. the bot uses those words to find candidates, and can ask you which one you meant if several fit.

faq.q: will a search bring an archived issue back?
faq.a: no. including archived issues only makes them visible in the results; their state stays as it was.
